name: lem-hcb4-canonical-closeness
source: imports validated registry lemma proofs/lem-hcb4-canonical-closeness — Canonical Ha closeness: there are universal C_sp < infinity and e_sp > 0 such that every H-CB datum with e <= e_sp satisfies max{||(Ha^Q_{P,Q})_n-J_{P,Q,n}||,||(Ha^Q_{Q,P})_n-J_{Q,P,n}||} <= C_sp*e for every n >= 1.
